I saved it to memory and replied to Ilse in the DM. Bay 30 is now on record as their dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups, starting 2026-10-14. There was no earlier dock on file to replace. That check ran on keyword search only, though, so an older note worded differently could have been missed.

The memory system stored the fact with "world" visibility rather than as a private note, so other people using the brain may be able to read it. It's a low-sensitivity detail. Still, it came from a DM, so I won't bring it up in anyone else's conversation.
